finalists.label: Rosacea
finalists.why: Rosacea has the most specific for evidence, including exacerbation by sunlight exposure and recurrent pustular eruptions on the face.

finalists.label: Acne
finalists.why: Acne has specific for evidence, including intermittent occurrence with erythematous papules and prominent pustules, and intrafollicular and subcorneal pustule formation.

frontier_selector.why: Rosacea is chosen as the champion because it accounts for the most decisive findings in the vignette, including exacerbation by sunlight exposure and recurrent pustular eruptions on the face, which are not fully explained by Acne.
